title: Chess Observatory vocabulary and integration work register
revision_scope: Working-tree implementation accompanying this atlas; the final release receipt owns exact checked-byte identity.
scope: Public project vocabulary, field bindings and proposed work. This JSON is not an OWL ontology, executed reasoner, complete event JSON Schema or certification profile.

sources.use: Rule context, especially attacked-square semantics and distinct claim/automatic draw rules; not evidence that local software passed.
Search score interpretation; an engine score is not a generic win probability.
Browser/scene API contracts; native execution needs its own receipt.
Shape.pointerEvents is an X_ITE extension; portable projection records its removal.
Entity/activity provenance hooks and domain/range discipline.
Concept scheme hooks for classification; a taxonomy does not prove domain truth.

classes.definition: A particular game lifetime, locally identified by game_id and generation, with its history scope.
Serialized occupancy, turn, rights and counters at a stated episode/ply; FEN alone does not preserve repetition history.
A typed score and bound referring to the actual searched or heuristically scored position.
A scoped rule check, such as an attack query, legal-move set, pin ray or tested move transition; exactness is limited to its declared rule question.
A geometric candidate, feature vector, swing record or adjudication with declared semantics and subject.
An X3D document, live scene state or raster figure with declared source, mapping, camera and losses.
A particular byte sequence, identified by digest algorithm and digest, distinct from a filename or its meaning.
Engine executable or JS/WASM identities and available build metadata, separate from search options and outcomes.
A curated question with input variants, rule witnesses, probes and a bounded explanation.
A report of subject, instrument, scope, acceptance facet and result; distinct from the run that generated it.
An attempted or accepted move from one identified position to another, with complete occupancy changes.
A particular search using an engine build, options, position/history and budget.
An actual execution of a named instrument against identified input bytes or state.
An actual rendering execution, including consumer/runtime, appearance changes, view and workload.
A classification term. Classification is independent of implementation or evidence status.
A bounded proposal with owner domains, dependencies and acceptance evidence; not a current capability.

relations.meaning: The exact position addressed, including history scope where relevant.
Binds state to one lifetime; a reused board ID is insufficient.
The property tested, not a global quality score.
A record explicitly identifies an earlier record and comparable scope. It does not imply equal result or independent instrumentation.
A search, check or render run used an identified source, input, engine or configuration entity.
An observation, exported artifact or receipt was generated by an identified actual run.
A declared derivation, such as a portable projection from owned runtime XML; preserve the transformation and losses.
Connect actual activities, not their JSON receipt files; this is not an alias for record reproduction.

field_bindings.semantics: Pair required for a game lifetime; game_id alone may be reused. Neither field identifies global users or games.
Freshness/order context. seq is not a position hash; a server snapshot batch may share its high-watermark sequence across boards.
Move events carry the post-move board. Preserve turn, castling/en-passant rights and counters when required by the consumer.
Play-search scores bind to the pre-move position; never silently attach them to the resulting board.
Original serialized input where retained; distinguish it from rules-library-normalized fen, especially unavailable en-passant rights.
Union across transports; Python engine events do not emit material_proxy. Do not compare different kinds as ordinary exact centipawns.
White-positive numeric score or a separate mate score. Missing is null, not zero; a mate distance is not a centipawn sample.
White-perspective bounds; converting from Black reverses lower/upper. Nonexact and mate samples leave the numeric swing window.
Candidate labels and legal discovery witnesses have different scopes. A verified exposing move does not establish optimal play or a win.

Browser WASM/replay claims only reached threefold/100-halfmove conditions; server can also recognize a legal intended next move enabling a claim. Claims and caps are adjudicated; automatic endings are not. Policies are not parity claims.
Retain the actual reason and policy. Engine/server ply cap differs from browser replay cap; this list is not the entire terminal-reason enumeration.
Fields of x3dchess.observation/1; bind a curated case to the current raw input and checked catalog bytes.
Static model occupancy with authored appearance. Full live history, workers, animation pose and clocks are excluded.

measurement_conventions.score: White-positive search score, with engine identity/options/budget and kind retained. Display division by 100 does not make the result a physical pawn count or probability.
measurement_conventions.material: Authored proxy P=1, N=3, B=3, R=5, Q=9; White minus Black. No SI unit or universal exchange-value claim.
measurement_conventions.pressure: White geometric attackers minus Black geometric attackers per square, including pinned attackers. Not legal destinations, safety, territory probability or an engine evaluation.
measurement_conventions.features: phaseSpacePoint returns material_balance, space_control and king_safety; heterogeneous authored heuristics, not learned phase space. Visual clipping/scaling can merge distinct positions.
measurement_conventions.coordinates: Owned X3D board uses a right-handed Y-up frame, files increasing along +X and rank 1 on +Z. One authored board square has width 1 scene unit. Consumer import may transform axes; record that transform before comparison.
measurement_conventions.hash: Store algorithm plus artifact digest. Byte identity is separate from semantic position identity, publisher authentication and correctness.
measurement_conventions.time: Record measurement unit, clock scope, workload, hardware, runtime and concurrency. A configured deadline or board-count bound is not achieved performance.

concept_schemes.note: Mode is independent of outcome and instrument. Executed parity may still be two implementations agreeing on the wrong meaning.
A blocked browser is not_run, never pass. A successful narrower instrument does not upgrade another facet.
Use per feature and acceptance scope, not one global maturity score.
Representation classes name different preserved information, not interchangeable serializations of a whole application.

current_capabilities.label: Shared requested-board layout
current_capabilities.boundary: 1–64 structural configurations; native performance remains unmeasured.

current_capabilities.label: Bounded event acceptance and async scene ownership
current_capabilities.boundary: SAI-adapter controls include null-score bar/tint clearing and terminal state reset; they do not establish native scheduling, visibility or picking.

current_capabilities.label: Typed analysis and searched-position identity
current_capabilities.boundary: Bounded geometric candidates and neutral sample swings; not best-move attribution or forced wins.

current_capabilities.label: Engine lifecycle, history and explicit adjudication policies
current_capabilities.boundary: Actual Node-adapted WASM controls are narrower than browser Worker startup; claim policies differ.

current_capabilities.label: Four curated rule studies with seven source variants
current_capabilities.boundary: A controlled catalog with legal probes and zero game actions after terminal adjudication; retained raw move-generator witnesses are distinct. Not arbitrary puzzle import, search or ratings.

current_capabilities.label: Portable static position export and runtime capture validation
current_capabilities.boundary: Deterministic classic export default; UI passes the selected palette. Declared pointerEvents projection; schema/semantic checks do not establish chess geometry, native pixels or full application serialization.

current_capabilities.label: One actual Blender import, occupancy check and authored still
current_capabilities.boundary: Five imported mesh centers/base heights in one study. Typography remains imperfect; full topology/material/annotation equivalence and reverse export are unproved.

current_capabilities.label: Actual native browser rendering
current_capabilities.boundary: Recorded not_run: this host blocks Chromium socket operations. No native screenshot/GPU claim follows from Blender or Node results.

study_hooks.question: Can a pinned knight still attack the king's proposed destination?
How can removing two pawns expose a distant rook ray?
Why is a safe destination insufficient for a king route?
When can taking less material avoid stalemate?

work_register.title: Actual native-browser execution
work_register.action: Run pinned replay/WASM/Study modes with 1/20/64 boards and partial rows; exercise picking, themes, reduced motion, reset/undo and actual Workers.
work_register.acceptance: Bind assertions, screenshots, console outcomes, hashes, browser/backend and scene state in scoped receipts; blocked startup remains not_run.

work_register.title: Measured target-device workload
work_register.action: Measure frame-time percentiles, memory/nodes, parse/commit time, queue age and search throughput at fixed engine budgets with heat on/off.
work_register.acceptance: Record device, runtime, workload, measurement interval and instrument; report achieved values separately from configured bounds.

work_register.title: Current-position relation inspector
work_register.action: Extend the curated Lens to selected-square attackers, legal destinations and pin rays; add a promotion chooser before arbitrary play.
work_register.acceptance: Pinned attacks, double check, en-passant exposure and promotions have positive/negative controls; delayed relations cannot survive a position revision.

work_register.title: Broader semantic import/export round trip
work_register.action: Extend the existing one-study Blender occupancy check to all piece types/special moves and an export/reimport route; inspect actual geometry independently of embedded metadata.
work_register.acceptance: Compare color/type/square/turn and declared retained fields; intentionally moved XML geometry must fail even if original FEN metadata survives; retain separate XSD gates.

work_register.title: Bounded PGN replay
work_register.action: Import a bounded game/line with SetUp/FEN context and source identity, legal stepping/undo and text-only comments.
work_register.acceptance: Legal move checks cover promotion and Black-to-move starts; no claim that imported evaluations were recomputed.

work_register.title: Feature-space collision study
work_register.action: Curate equal/near-equal authored feature points with different legal moves or terminal states; expose raw values and clipping.
work_register.acceptance: Each point resolves to its actual board/ply; exact rule witnesses establish the differing property without invented forced-outcome claims.

work_register.title: Bounded verified search branches
work_register.action: Add a small focused MultiPV view with searched position, engine/options and depth/nodes/time identities.
work_register.acceptance: Legally replay every drawn line; reject corrupt PVs and stale results; label selected continuations rather than exhaustive proof.

work_register.title: Controlled tournament comparisons
work_register.action: Specify openings, color-swapped pairs, stopping/adjudication policy and uncertainty before comparing settings.
work_register.acceptance: Separate wins/losses/draws/adjudications/search failures and show sample size; a small demonstration does not establish an engine rating.

work_register.title: Durable episode replay
work_register.action: Add a durable accepted-event ledger and history identity rather than equating current snapshots with crash recovery.
work_register.acceptance: Interrupt a process, resume consumption and verify no duplicate moves or old-generation visual commits; preserve policy/version identity.

work_register.title: Visual regression and accessibility
work_register.action: Use deterministic scene/camera states, masks/occupancy readback, contrast and picking checks, noncolor cues and keyboard focus tests.
work_register.acceptance: Record per-theme tested views and reduced-motion behavior; masks prove scoped visibility rather than tactical truth; repair imported typography separately.

work_register.title: Formal observation schema and graph adapter
work_register.action: Define a real observation JSON Schema and a read-only provenance adapter using the subject/facet/scope distinctions here.
work_register.acceptance: Reject wrong-FEN scores, unrelated render evidence, unrun records reported as passes and changed artifact bytes; use PROV activity relations only between actual runs.

work_register.title: Additional renderers and piece assets
work_register.action: Evaluate a small attributed glTF/alternate-consumer piece set against the same verified game/event model and special-move fixtures.
work_register.acceptance: Measure node/draw/parse costs, retain source/license and declare material/interaction losses; legible squares and chess semantics remain acceptance conditions.

cross_project_contracts.handoff: One counterexample lesson card per study with prediction, probe, witness and explanation.
cross_project_contracts.owner_boundary: Retain the mathematical teaching sequence; consume exact chess witnesses rather than duplicate rule kernels.

cross_project_contracts.handoff: Reuse source state, derived relation, visual mapping and declared export-loss distinctions.
cross_project_contracts.owner_boundary: Each scientific domain retains its numerical model, units, uncertainty and independent witnesses.

cross_project_contracts.handoff: Public synthetic SAI/extension fixtures and paired passing/failing controls.
cross_project_contracts.owner_boundary: API or schema correctness is separate from domain correctness and native visual evidence.

cross_project_contracts.handoff: Discovery cards for the spectator, rule studies and declared offline still.
cross_project_contracts.owner_boundary: Verify actual live destination and intended consumer before publishing capability claims.

cross_project_contracts.handoff: Public-safe study records, known wrong explanations, provenance and explicit train/evaluation splits if datasets are built.
cross_project_contracts.owner_boundary: This patch does not copy private corpus material, integrate a private archive or establish model performance.

cross_project_contracts.handoff: Typed observations and reproducible fixtures for stale state, score identity, motif semantics and export loss.
cross_project_contracts.owner_boundary: Keep existing orchestration/scorekeeping; do not collapse unrelated acceptance facets into another global scalar.

evidence_policy: Historical RESULTS.md describes the earlier port; current module receipts and final aggregate records have their own scopes.
A source inspection is not an executed test. A successful adapter, Node engine or Blender run is not native browser proof.
Known-answer rule controls establish meaning before cross-language parity; matching output alone does not establish correctness.
Each observation should identify subject, instrument, facet, outcome, artifact hashes and limitations relevant to its claim.
This register proposes integrations with sibling projects; it does not claim those repositories were changed by this chess patch.
